text:
Carlos: Quick one  corpcard declined at SFO valet/parking kiosk so I paid valet on personal card. Charged $58.00 (valet) + $12.00 for overnight garage = $70.00. Attached pic of ticket val_ticket.jpg and photo of kiosk receipt kiosk.jpg. Trip 2026-11-05. @Mina can you approve reimbursement?
Priya - Finance: Sorry about the decline. For parking we need: 1) parking ticket or folio showing plate/entry time (val_ticket.jpg), 2) kiosk receipt showing the charge, and 3) note in Concur explaining corpcard declined. If the kiosk prints a truncated merchant name we may need vendor confirmation.
Carlos: Uploaded both images to Concur, expense ID EXP-2026-1105-3329. Note says "corpcard declined; personal card used; attached kiosk receipt and ticket."
Mina - Manager: Approved. Carlos, are any of those charges client-billable or event-related?
Carlos: No, this was travel to a vendor meeting, company-paid. Not client-billable.
ParkingOpsBot: Vendor ticket PARK-781 created to request full merchant invoice from SkyPark LLC. Some garages batch under different acquirers; include kiosk reference PRK-5567.
Priya - Finance: One nuance: if the corpcard later posts the same charge, we'll reconcile and reverse the reimbursement. Also note that some parking kiosks add a convenience fee; those fees are non-reimbursable unless manager pre-approves. Does kiosk show a separate convenience fee?
Carlos: Kiosk receipt shows two lines: "Valet $58.00" and "Service Fee $2.00" (total $60.00) plus overnight garage $10.00 printed separately (total $70.00). I paid $70.00 on my Visa ending 9876. I added a note in Concur labeling $2.00 service fee as convenience.
Priya - Finance: We'll reimburse $68.00 (valet $58 + garage $10) and hold the $2 convenience fee as non-reimbursable per policy, unless manager signs off as exceptional. Mina, okay to approve the $2 fee?
Mina - Manager: Not necessary to cover convenience fee for parking. Approved only business charges. Mina approves $68.00.
Carlos: Understood. Submitted EXP-2026-1105-3329 with split lines: Valet $58.00 (TL_PARKING), Garage overnight $10.00 (TR_PARKING), Convenience fee $2.00 (NON_REIMB).
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-1105-3329 submitted by Carlos at 2026-11-06 13:41 UTC. Status: awaiting finance processing.
Priya - Finance: Received — we'll queue for expedited reimbursement and request merchant invoice from PARK-781. If CardOps finds a corpcard post for $70.00, we'll reconcile: repay OOP or reverse reimbursement.
ParkingOpsBot: PARK-781 update: SkyPark provided a vendor invoice showing merchant name "SKY PARKING LLC" and tax ID; invoice matches valet+garage but lists service fee as a mandatory kiosk processing fee.
Priya - Finance: Since vendor confirms service fee is mandatory, we can process the full $70.00 as reimbursable under manager exception. Mina, can you confirm you approve the service fee as mandatory?
Mina - Manager: I approve the full amount $70.00 given vendor's confirmation that fee is mandatory. Mina approves service fee exception.
Priya - Finance: Noted. We'll process full $70.00. Tagging expense TL_PARKING and marking as manager-exception for $2. Expense will be reimbursed in the next pay run (3-5 business days).
Carlos: Thanks. One last ask: can CardOps whitelist SKY PARKING LLC or the descriptor so future kiosks don't block? I can drop the kiosk reference PRK-5567 in the ticket.
Priya - Finance: Good idea. ParkingOpsBot, please add descriptor mapping request to PARK-781 and notify CardOps.
ParkingOpsBot: Descriptor mapping request added to PARK-781 and CardOps notified.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-1105-3329 processed by finance at 2026-11-09 10:07 UTC. Status: paid.
Priya - Finance: Closing thread — payment complete. If you see any corpcard post for this, we'll reconcile. :white_check_mark:
